candidate.statement: Among prostate cancer patients receiving 177Lu-PSMA therapy, high PSMA expression is associated with improved progression-free survival compared to low/negative PSMA expression.
queries: lutetium PSMA high uptake worse PFS prostate

review.rationale: Multiple clinical studies and meta-analyses directly evaluate patients with prostate cancer receiving 177Lu-PSMA therapy and show that higher baseline PSMA expression/uptake (e.g., higher total tumor SUVmean, meeting rigorous PSMA-avidity inclusion criteria) is significantly associated with improved progression-free survival (PSA PFS or PFS). Specifically, MED:41679922 demonstrated that higher baseline total tumor SUVmean on PSMA PET was independently associated with improved PSA-PFS (HR 0.58, p=0.007) and OS in patients treated with 177Lu-PSMA. Similarly, MED:42313302 found that patients meeting stricter PSMA expression/avidity criteria had significantly longer PSA-PFS (4.3 vs. 1.5 vs. 2.8 months, p=0.002), and MED:41748296 meta-analyzed 23 studies confirming SUVmean as a significant predictor of PFS.

queries: enzalutamide AR-V7 positive superior PFS prostate

review.rationale: Abstract MED:41922546 reports on mCRPC patients treated with androgen receptor pathway inhibitors (abiraterone or enzalutamide) in the PROPHECY trial, demonstrating that AR-V7-positive patients (both nuclear and cytoplasmic) had significantly worse progression-free survival (PFS) compared to AR-V7-negative patients. This directly supports the hypothesis that AR-V7 positivity is associated with shorter PFS in prostate cancer patients treated with enzalutamide.

review.rationale: In MED:41922546 (PROPHECY trial), circulating tumor cell AR-V7 status was evaluated in mCRPC patients treated with abiraterone or enzalutamide.
